fn FactorsInFactorial(n: Int, p: Int) -> Int
  requires (p > 1)
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else ((n / p) + FactorsInFactorial((n / p), p))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (n == 0)) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((not (n > 0)) or (result == ((n / p) + FactorsInFactorial((n / p), p))))
  effects pure
  example (FactorsInFactorial(0, 2) == 0)
  example (FactorsInFactorial(2, 2) == 1)
{
  if (n == 0) then 0 else ((n / p) + FactorsInFactorial((n / p), p))
}

fn FactorsInDoubleFactorial(n: Int, p: Int) -> Int
  requires (p > 1)
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 0) then 0 else if ((n % 2) == 1) then (FactorsInFactorial(n, p) - FactorsInDoubleFactorial((n - 1), p)) else (FactorsInFactorial((n / 2), p) + (if (p == 2) then (n / 2) else 0))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((not (n <= 0)) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((not ((n > 0) and ((n % 2) == 1))) or (result == (FactorsInFactorial(n, p) - FactorsInDoubleFactorial((n - 1), p))))
  ensures ((not ((n > 0) and ((n % 2) == 0))) or (result == (FactorsInFactorial((n / 2), p) + (if (p == 2) then (n / 2) else 0))))
  effects pure
  example (FactorsInDoubleFactorial(0, 2) == 0)
  example (FactorsInDoubleFactorial(2, 2) == 1)
{
  if (n <= 0) then 0 else if ((n % 2) == 1) then (FactorsInFactorial(n, p) - FactorsInDoubleFactorial((n - 1), p)) else (FactorsInFactorial((n / 2), p) + (if (p == 2) then (n / 2) else 0))
}

fn solve(N: Int) -> Int
  requires (N >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (FactorsInDoubleFactorial(N, 2) < FactorsInDoubleFactorial(N, 5)) then FactorsInDoubleFactorial(N, 2) else FactorsInDoubleFactorial(N, 5)))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0) == 0)
